notes.title: Hymer 2000 Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

Developed by doBell Studio, the team behind SELF, and published by indienova, the interactive text adventure game Hymer 2000 has launched its demo today!

Hymer 2000 is an interactive text-based puzzle game. You can converse freely with a computer named Hymer, without being confined to a fixed set of text options. The game features an open-ended search function that allows you to enter any keyword to locate conversational logs between Hymer and others. Throughout this process, you will uncover new keywords, gather clues, collect "faces," and ultimately unveil the secret Hymer has been guarding before shutting it down once and for all.[/p][p]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255860/2000/"][/dynamiclink]

The demo includes roughly the first 20–30 minutes of gameplay, with some limitations placed on the "search" feature. The full version is scheduled to release by the end of the year—stay tuned!

Discord：[url="https://discord.gg/nbHP7hMefC"]https://discord.gg/nbHP7hMefC[/url]
[/p]
